argv:
set -euo pipefail
values=$$(/usr/bin/jq -n --arg start_app "$$START_APP" --arg sdk_python "$$SDK_PYTHON" --arg console_tool "$$CONSOLE_TOOL" '{start_app:$$start_app,sdk_python:$$sdk_python,console_tool:$$console_tool}')
while IFS= read -r row; do
 file=$$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.file' <<<"$$row")
 edits=$$(/usr/bin/jq -c '.edits' <<<"$$row")
 temporary=$$(/usr/bin/mktemp "$$file.update-XXXXXX")
 /usr/bin/jq --argjson edits "$$edits" --argjson values "$$values" 'reduce $$edits[] as $$edit (. ; setpath($$edit.path; $$values[$$edit.parameter]))' "$$file" >"$$temporary"
 /bin/chmod --reference="$$file" "$$temporary"
 /bin/mv -- "$$temporary" "$$file"
done < <(/usr/bin/jq -c '.json[]' "$$PUBLICATION")
while IFS= read -r row; do
 file=$$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.file' <<<"$$row")
 key=$$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.key' <<<"$$row")
 parameter=$$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.parameter' <<<"$$row")
 value=$$(/usr/bin/jq -r --arg key "$$parameter" '.[$$key]' <<<"$$values")
 temporary=$$(/usr/bin/mktemp "$$file.update-XXXXXX")
 /usr/bin/sed "s|^$$key=.*$$|$$key='$$value'|" "$$file" >"$$temporary"
 /bin/chmod --reference="$$file" "$$temporary"
 /bin/mv -- "$$temporary" "$$file"
done < <(/usr/bin/jq -c '.shell[]' "$$PUBLICATION")
